bio.text: Pete Ricketts was sworn in as a U.S. Senator from Nebraska on January 23, 2023.
He served as Nebraska's 40th Governor from January 8, 2015, and was re-elected in November 2018.
Born in Nebraska City and raised in Omaha, he earned a bachelor's degree in biology and an MBA from the University of Chicago.
Before public office he worked at Union Pacific and then in his family's business that became Ameritrade, where he held roles including Chief Operating Officer.
